mapper.select: SELECT ua.id,u1.id as uId,ua.state as myState,a.activityName,a.activityDate,a.startTime,a.activityAddress,a.activityPoint,t.type,u2.name,u2.telephone,actstate.state as aState FROM user_activity ua JOIN activity a ON ua.aId = a.id JOIN activity_state actstate ON a.state=actstate.id JOIN activity_type t ON a.activityTypeId=t.id JOIN user u2 ON a.dId = u2.id JOIN user u1 ON ua.uId = u1.id WHERE uId = #{uId}

SELECT ua.id,u1.id as uId,ua.state as myState,a.activityName,a.activityDate,a.startTime,a.activityAddress,a.activityPoint,t.type,u2.name,u2.telephone,actstate.state as aState FROM user_activity ua JOIN activity a ON ua.aId = a.id JOIN activity_state actstate ON a.state=actstate.id JOIN activity_type t ON a.activityTypeId=t.id JOIN user u2 ON a.dId = u2.id JOIN user u1 ON ua.uId = u1.id WHERE u1.id = #{uId} AND ua.state = #{state}
